description: Defines the CandidateAttachmentModel class, which represents a data model for candidate attachments in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization traits and maps recruitment attachment data for API responses.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes recruitment candidate attachment data for API responses, implementing normalization and filtering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a RecruitmentAttachment entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings.
